rationale: The system failed to retrieve the CAPEC attack patterns associated with T1557, resulting in an abstention. Consequently, it failed to identify any of the 5 expected alternate names: 'Man-in-the-Middle / MITM', 'Monkey-in-the-Middle', 'Monster-in-the-Middle', 'On-path Attacker', and 'Person-in-the-Middle / PiTM'.
